_comment: Spells, from the 5e SRD (see docs/SPELLS.md for every key). range_ft and size_ft are in feet (5 ft = 1 hex). 'higher' is what each slot level above the spell's own adds.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: Hurl a mote of fire: a ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire damage.

light.name: Light
light.description: Make an object shed bright light. (No effect in the game yet.)

mage_hand.name: Mage Hand
mage_hand.description: A spectral hand that can carry small things. (No effect in the game yet.)

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Radiance falls on a creature you can see: a Dexterity save, or 1d8 radiant damage.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: Touch an ally: they add 1d4 to their next ability check (picking a lock, say).

spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare_the_dying.description: Touch a dying ally: they become stable and stop making death saves.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Three glowing darts that never miss, each 1d4+1 force damage. One more dart per slot level above 1st.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: A 15-foot cone of flame: everyone in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage, or half on a success. Friends too.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Roll 5d8: creatures within 20 feet of a point fall asleep, those with the fewest hit points first, until the roll is used up. Undead don't sleep. Friends in the area aren't spared.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: When an attack would hit you, +5 armour class until your next turn, which may turn the hit into a miss. Cast for you automatically when it would.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.description: Touch an ally who wears no armour: their armour class becomes 13 + Dexterity until a long rest.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Up to three allies within 30 feet add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute (concentration). One more ally per slot level above 1st.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: Touch an ally: they regain 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier hit points. Another 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A bonus action: an ally within 60 feet regains 1d4 + your Wisdom modifier hit points.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage. The next attack against the target, before the end of your next turn, has advantage.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.description: Three rays of fire, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire damage.

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.description: A bonus action: step through silver mist to an empty spot you can see within 30 feet, without provoking opportunity attacks.

aid.name: Aid
aid.description: Up to three allies gain 5 maximum and current hit points until a long rest. 5 more per slot level above 2nd.
